posts.title: From the Archive: Lee Kuan Yew on India – Part 4
posts.description: “Give me six hours to chop down a tree and I will spend the first four sharpening the axe,” said Abe Lincoln. posts.title: Poverty, Property and Prosperity
posts.description: We take property to be as natural as the air we breathe because it’s all around us and we are used to it. But the idea of property is a relatively modern and quite artificial construct. It’s an entirely human construct, as artificial as a car or a mobile phone.
